run_flops_profile: run get_flops_profile on a PyTorch model with input data to measure total FLOPs
run_flops_profile_verbose: run get_flops_profile with verbose=True to print a detailed per-layer model profile
test_get_flops_profile: test get_flops_profile by passing a model and sample input data and asserting FLOPs returned
review_get_flops_profile: review get_flops_profile to verify FlopsProfiler is correctly started, stopped, and FLOPs extracted
refactor_get_flops_profile: refactor get_flops_profile to support batched input data or multiple forward passes
